intro.text: An order of the ancient Knights Radiant, varied but sharing a love of adventure, novelty and oddity, and thought by some capricious and unreliable.
An order of the Knights Radiant who use Transportation and Cohesion and focus on freedom, self-expression and freeing captives.

description.text: Vorin theology associates them with the number eight, the amethyst polestone, the Essence of Foil and the Divine Attributes Resolute and Builder.
Willshapers use the Surges of Transportation and Cohesion.
They focus on personal fulfilment, radical self-expression, and freeing those who are captive.

items.text: Willshapers varied in personality, but generally enjoyed discovering new and strange things; some found them capricious and unreliable.
In peace, they used their powers to construct buildings and infrastructure and train the people living there; in war, they fortified towns.
Like the Elsecallers, they were thought to have an affinity for Shadesmar.
Venli practises her powers as a Willshaper by shaping stone; three other spren like hers want to bond her squires.
Venli brings a Reacher to the listeners, hoping the spren will bond her mother.
Cohesion lets a Willshaper make stone malleable, like clay or even liquid, and connects them deeply to the spren of the stone.
Like most Radiants, Willshapers have squires.
Willshapers who are also Regals are highly resistant to fabrials that stop Radiants from Surgebinding.
